question: Should this PR be the canonical implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100978, and is its `operator.read` Gateway method plus lazy per-agent FTS reconciliation an acceptable transcript-search boundary?
rationale: The PR exposes transcript-content discovery through a new core Gateway/tool surface and adds persisted index state, while a maintainer-authored competing implementation is also open; automation cannot choose the product/security boundary or canonical branch.

options.title: Pick Canonical Boundary First
options.body: Keep this PR open but unmerged until maintainers choose between this branch and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101257 and record the accepted read-scope/index lifecycle.

options.title: Accept This Branch
options.body: Proceed with this PR after explicit signoff that `operator.read` transcript discovery and lazy reconciliation are the intended v1 contract.

options.title: Supersede With Maintainer PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101257 as the landing path after it is clean and proof-positive, then close this PR with that provenance.

recommendation.title: Pick Canonical Boundary First
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but unmerged until maintainers choose between this branch and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101257 and record the accepted read-scope/index lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the canonical feature issue, authored adjacent session-management direction, and own the competing maintainer implementation.
